tool.name: ChronAeon PhyloGeo
tool.description: Discrete phylogeography and spatial transmission network inference

Resolve index -> name from the header. #if $meta.kind == "tabular": --location-col "\$(head -n1 '$meta.metadata' | tr '\t' ',' | cut -d',' -f$meta.location_col)" #if $meta.strain_col: --strain-col "\$(head -n1 '$meta.metadata' | tr '\t' ',' | cut -d',' -f$meta.strain_col)" #end if #if $meta.date_col: --date-col "\$(head -n1 '$meta.metadata' | tr '\t' ',' | cut -d',' -f$meta.date_col)" #end if #if $meta.lat_col: --lat-col "\$(head -n1 '$meta.metadata' | tr '\t' ',' | cut -d',' -f$meta.lat_col)" #end if #if $meta.lon_col: --lon-col "\$(head -n1 '$meta.metadata' | tr '\t' ',' | cut -d',' -f$meta.lon_col)" #end if #end if #if $root_taxon: --root-taxon '$root_taxon' #end if --n-perms $n_perms --min-bf $min_bf --fdr $fdr $no_neural #if $plot: --plot --plot-path chronaeon_phylogeo_plot.pdf #end if #if $geojson: --geojson chronaeon_phylogeo.geojson #end if @MODEL_SOURCE@ #if $output_json: --output chronaeon_phylogeo.json #end if #if $output_csv: --csv '$csv_output' #end if

tool.help:
ChronAeon PhyloGeo: Discrete Phylogeography & Spatial Transmission Networks =============================================================================
**What question does this method answer?**
What are the significant transmission routes between geographic locations for a pathogen population, and what is the strength of evidence for each route?
**How it works**
ChronAeon PhyloGeo infers discrete phylogeographic transmission networks using neural attention-based branch assignment or classical tree transitions. Statistical significance is assessed via permutation-based Bayes Factors and FDR correction.
**Inputs**
- A FASTA alignment - Metadata with location labels (CSV/TSV or Auspice JSON) - A phylogenetic tree (Newick) - Optional model weights source (Hugging Face Hub variant or local .pt file). To see available model variants, run the 'HyphAeon List Models' tool.
**Outputs**
- **JSON**: full transmission network with Bayes Factors and FDR-corrected p-values - **CSV**: tabular transmission routes - **Plot (PDF)**: optional diagnostic figure - **GeoJSON**: optional feature collection for map visualization
